title: Three Nights and One Short Case
subtitle: 战争和平 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 战争和平（人与社会·历史社会与文化·战争与和平）
meta: 主题语境：战争和平（人与社会·历史社会与文化·战争与和平）　|　核心词汇：gun　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 gun 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 the sergeant ① cleaned a gun that no soldier in the camp would have described, and he said the cleaning was the whole of the night. The ② gun, meaning the weapon itself and not the holster, ran three nights and stayed undescribed in the book; a gun, he said, is the only thing in a camp that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ gun in that camp had the same short case beside it, and the ④ gun at the far rack, meaning the one they kept for the children to see and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A gun, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the sergeant said the describing is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the gun was the whole of the matter, meaning the signal and not the weapon. The ⑥ gun, meaning the signal and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; gun, he said, is either something you clean or the only word that means both a weapon and a signal. He said the signal is the part they remember.

By 1969 the ⑦ gun had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short case. The ⑧ gun of the whole thing, the sergeant wrote in November, was one camp and three nights of describing; gun, he said, is either the one at the far rack or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ gun I remember is the one described in the report, which closed in 1971 and is still described as the quietest in the camp. A ⑩ gun, my mother said in 1973, is the only one that improves by being described; every gun, she said, is a signal that has agreed to look like a weapon. She said the signal was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 枪；枪支（指营地里每一支旁边的那一支）
B. n. 枪；枪支（指那件武器本身，与枪套相对）
C. 固定搭配：clean a gun 擦枪
D. n. 枪（指留给孩子们看的那支）
E. n. 枪械（抽象总称，指一处营地的枪支之事）
F. n. 枪（指报告里写到、被登记过的那支）
G. n. 信号枪；起跑信号（指一件事里人人都等却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 发令（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: cleaned a gun that no soldier in the camp would have described
The gun, meaning the weapon itself and not the holster
the gun at the far rack
the gun was the whole of the matter
the gun had become a line in a report
The gun of the whole thing
A gun, my mother said in 1973

answers.why: clean a gun 意为“擦枪”，1964 年那位中士擦了一支营地里没有一位士兵肯描述的枪。
gun 意为“枪、枪支”，指那件武器本身而不是枪套，它经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被描述。
gun 意为“枪、枪支”，指营地里每一支旁边的那一支，每一支旁边都有同一只矮矮的枪盒。
gun 意为“枪”，指最远那个枪架上留给孩子们看的那支，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
gun 意为“信号枪、发令信号”，指一件事里人人都等却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这一声发令就是那件事的全部。
gun 意为“发令”，指人人都等却无人提起的那样东西而不是那支枪，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
gun 意为“枪”，指报告里写到、被登记过的那支，到 1969 年这一支成了报告里的一行。
gun 意为“枪械”，中士十一月写道，整件事的枪支之事是一处营地和三个夜晚的描述。
gun 意为“枪”，我记得的是报告里描述过的那支，1971 年上交了，至今仍被说成营地里最安静的一支。
gun 为抽象总称，母亲 1973 年说，枪是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的武器。
